name: Caiman

review.observation: Full original: complete connected side-on caiman, four visible foot endpoints, broad closed snout and rows of dorsal scutes. The far proximal limbs are partially occluded; no all-visible anatomy claim. Tail and snout are inside canvas but side margins appear below the requested 8 percent; retain framing hold if measured. Subject is larger than the requested half-canvas composition.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.
